issues.description: The problem statement and UML require the Farm to hold its animals in a List, specifically initialized as an ArrayList in the no-argument constructor. The solution implementation uses a Set (HashSet) for the animals collection (and corresponding getters/setters), which conflicts with the specified List/ArrayList requirement. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected collection type and the constructor initialization (ArrayList vs. HashSet).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the collection type consistent with the problem statement: use List<Animal> as the field type and initialize it as a new ArrayList<>() in the no-argument constructor. Update getters/setters and any iteration logic accordingly. Alternatively, if Set semantics are intended, update the problem statement and UML to state Set/HashSet instead of List/ArrayList.
